adjudication.structural_theorem: v2_perp - v2_par = G_c/rho = (I_omega/(4 rho)) * m^2 exactly. The carrier branch splitting is carried by the SAME modulus that opens the gap, so a single carrier limiting velocity requires G_c = 0, i.e. NO GAP. No choice of positive moduli makes both carrier branches equal c_EM = sqrt(G/rho).

constructive_v_equals_c_conditions.both_simultaneously: requires G_c == 0, i.e. the gap CLOSES — no positive-moduli solution exists with a massive carrier
constructive_v_equals_c_conditions.translational_transverse_branch: identically satisfied: v^2 == G/rho == c_EM^2 for ALL moduli (the G_c direct stiffness is exactly cancelled by the k·p level repulsion)

relativistic_form_validity_window.reading: k_break < k_rel on every carrier branch: the lattice bends the band over BEFORE the carrier reaches the regime where v would become its group velocity. The relativistic form is therefore a valid SMALL-k truncation whose named limiting velocity is never attained on this lattice — which is why the full-BZ group-velocity supplement reads BELOW c_EM even though the form's v exceeds it.
